How Spotly Works

Spotly helps you find properties and trusted property agents near you in just a few steps.

1
Search by location
Select your State, Local Government, Town, or Area to discover properties near you.
2
Browse properties

3

5
Save and follow
Save agents and follow your favorites to receive updates and notifications.
Spotly makes finding properties simple, fast, and trustworthy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to the most common questions about Spotly.

What is Spotly?
Spotly is a platform for discovering properties near you — houses, land, shops, offices and more — and the trusted agents who list them.
Is Spotly free to use?
Yes. Searching for properties and contacting agents is completely free.
What is a "Verified ID" badge?
It will show an agent has submitted valid government-issued identification that Spotly's team has reviewed and approved. It confirms identity only — not the quality of their service. This feature is coming soon and isn't awarded yet.
How do I get a "Verified ID" badge?
Identity verification is still being developed and isn't open for submissions yet. There's nothing to upload or submit at this stage — check back once it launches.
What is a Premium badge?
It shows an agent is on Spotly's paid Premium Plan (₦2,000/month), which boosts visibility in search results and on the map, and unlocks extra features like more portfolio photos and videos.
How do I get a premium badge?
From your Agent Dashboard, tap "Upgrade to Premium — ₦2,000/month" and complete payment. Your badge and expiry date update immediately after payment is confirmed.
What are the prohibited activities on Spotly?
1. Impersonating other users or agents
2. Uploading illegal or harmful content
3. Committing fraud or misrepresentation
4. Harassing other users
5. Manipulating ratings or creating fake reviews
Should I chat or call the agent?
Spotly doesn't have in-app chat. You contact agents directly by Call or WhatsApp from the property or their profile, with no middleman.
How long will my premium ads stay on Spotly?
Your Premium Plan runs for 30 days from payment and expires automatically at the end of that period unless renewed.
How do I renew my Spotly Premium Plan?
Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Upgrade to Premium. Complete your payment before or after your current plan expires to extend your Premium subscription by another 30 days.
How often can I renew my Premium Plan?
As often as you like. You can renew any time, even before the current cycle ends.
What if my Premium Plan is closed?
Your profile drops back to the Free plan. You lose the Premium badge, priority placement, and video portfolio access, but your listing stays active and reachable.
How do I leave a review about an agent?
Open the agent's profile, tap the review/rating option, choose a star rating, and write your feedback. Only one review per agent per device is allowed.
How do I search for a property on Spotly?
Use the search bar on the home or search screen and type what you're looking for — for example a house, land or a shop — or tap an area or property type on the home screen. You can also switch to Map mode to browse properties near you.
How do I share my photos on the Market page?
Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Add Photos. Upload photos from your device, add an optional caption and hashtags, then tap Post to Market. Your uploaded photos are also added to your public profile. Free plan allows up to 4 photos, while Premium allows up to 10.
How do I share my videos on the Market page?
Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Add Video. Paste a YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram video link, add a title/caption, and publish it to the Market. Free plan lets you have 1 video live on the Market at a time; Premium allows up to 3 at once. Videos you add also appear on your public profile (Free plan: 2 videos, Premium: up to 10).
How long do my Market posts stay visible?
Free Plan: photo and video posts stay live for 7 days, then expire automatically, with up to 3 photo slots and 1 video slot at once. Premium Plan: both photo and video posts stay live for 30 days, then expire automatically unless reposted, with up to 10 photo slots and 3 video slots at once.
How do I find a property or agent on the map?
Open an agent's post on the Market and tap "Location," or go to Maps from the bottom nav and tap a pin to open it. Tap "Open in Google Maps" or "Get Directions" to navigate.
How do I view my business location on the map?
Go to Dashboard → My Profile and tap "View my business on Map" to preview your pin exactly as people see it. If no location is set, tap "Update Business Location" to add one.
How do I share my business location with people?
In your Agent Dashboard, find the location preview section and tap "Share Location" to open your device's share sheet (or WhatsApp) with a Google Maps directions link plus your Spotly profile link. Or tap "Copy Link" to copy the location link directly.
How do people get directions to me?
From your profile or a Market post, they tap "Open in Google Maps" or "Get Directions" for instant turn-by-turn navigation to your pin.
How do I share my agent profile?
Go to Dashboard → Share Profile and tap "Share" to open your device's native share sheet (or WhatsApp) with your profile link.
How do I update my agent profile?
Go to Dashboard → My Profile and edit your bio and location directly, then save. To change your name or phone number, contact Spotly support.
How do I upload photos to my profile?
Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Add Photos. Choose images from your device and upload them. Your photos will automatically appear on your public profile. Free plan allows up to 4 photos, while Premium allows up to 10.
How do I upload videos to my profile?
Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Add Video. Paste a YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram video link, add a title and description, then save. Free plan allows 2 videos, while Premium allows up to 10 — videos appear on your public profile and can also be shared to the Market.
How do I contact Spotly?
Open the menu → Contact Us, fill in your name, subject (Complaint, Account Issue, Payment Issue, Agent Issue, Report a Listing, Privacy / Data Request, General Inquiry, Partnership Enquiry), and message, then tap "Send Message." Spotly aims to respond within 24 hours on business days.
How do I report a problem or bug?
Go to Contact Us, select the closest matching subject (e.g. Account Issue), describe the bug clearly, and submit. Use this also for suspicious activity, fake profiles, or harmful content.

Safety Tips

Your safety is our priority.

Review the agent's profile and the property details carefully.
Read the agent's ratings and reviews.
Inspect the property in person, in daylight, and take someone with you when possible.
Do not pay anything before you have inspected the property and confirmed the agent’s identity.
Ask for a receipt and a written agreement for every payment.
Report suspicious behavior to Spotly.
Ask to see the property documents and verify the agent’s identity when necessary.
Keep communication within trusted channels.
Emergency Notice
If you feel unsafe or suspect fraud, stop the transaction immediately and contact local authorities.

About Spotly

Connecting communities with trusted property agents and listings.

Our Story

Spotly was created with one simple mission: to help people easily discover properties and trusted property agents around them.

Every day, people struggle to find available houses, land, shops and offices, while agents struggle to reach the people looking for them. We believed there should be a better way.

Instead of endless scrolling through entertainment content, Spotly was built as a platform that helps people discover real properties, real agents, and real opportunities in their local communities.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us.

Last Updated: September 2026

Who We Are

Spotly (“we”, “us”) is the data controller for the personal data described in this policy. We follow the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA) and the Nigeria Data Protection Commission’s (NDPC) General Application and Implementation Directive 2025. You can contact us about your personal data at support@spotly.ng.

Information We Collect

  • Account and profile: name, phone number, WhatsApp number, email address (optional), login details, agency name, years of experience and bio
  • Listings and content: property details, prices, photos, videos, captions and Market posts you upload
  • Location: your town, LGA, state and area, and precise GPS coordinates if you allow them (for example, to show properties near you or to place an agent on the map)
  • Identity verification: a government-issued ID and a selfie, if you choose to verify
  • Messages and reviews: what you send us through the Contact Us form, and reviews you write
  • Payments: Premium payments are processed by Flutterwave; we receive the payment status and reference
  • Usage and device information: pages viewed and basic device information, collected through analytics

Why We Use It and Our Legal Basis

  • To create and run your account, and to show your listings and agent profile — to perform our agreement with you
  • To take payments and manage Premium plans — to perform our agreement with you
  • To keep Spotly safe, prevent fraud and abuse, and answer support requests — our legitimate interests and legal obligations
  • To understand how Spotly is used and to improve it — our legitimate interests
  • To use your precise location, to verify your identity, and to send push notifications — your consent, which you can withdraw at any time
  • To comply with the law and respond to lawful requests from authorities — legal obligation

Identity Verification

Your ID document and selfie are sensitive personal data. We ask for them only if you choose to verify, and only with your explicit consent. They are used solely to check your identity, are never shown publicly, and are reviewed only by authorised Spotly staff. You can withdraw your consent by contacting us; if you do, your verification badge may be removed.

Location Information

Spotly uses your town, LGA, state and area to show properties near you. With your permission it also uses precise GPS coordinates for “near me” results and to place agents on the map. You can turn location off in your device or browser settings and still choose your area manually. Only property locations that an agent has chosen to show publicly appear as pins on the map.

What Is Public

If you are an agent, your name or agency name, profile, listings, photos, videos and the phone or WhatsApp contact details you provide are visible to people using Spotly, so that they can contact you. Do not add information you do not want to be public.

Who We Share It With

  • Service providers that help us run Spotly: Google (data storage, hosting, Google Maps and analytics), Flutterwave (payments), OneSignal (push notifications), and map, address-search and content services such as OpenStreetMap and Esri. They may only use your data to provide their service to us
  • Authorities: courts, the police and regulators, where the law requires or permits it
  • We do not sell your personal data and we do not use it for advertising

Transfers Outside Nigeria

Some of the services above process data outside Nigeria. Where this happens, we make sure it is done in line with the NDPA — for example, to a country or organisation with adequate protection, with appropriate safeguards in place, or with your consent.

How Long We Keep It

We keep personal data for as long as your account is active and as long as we need it for the purposes above, to meet legal, tax and accounting duties, and to prevent fraud. When it is no longer needed, or when you ask us to delete it and the law allows, we delete or anonymise it.

Security and Data Breaches

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information. If a data breach is likely to put your rights and freedoms at risk, we will notify the NDPC within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, and tell affected users without undue delay, as the NDPA requires.

Cookies, Local Storage and Analytics

We use local storage on your device to remember your location and login, and to load Spotly faster. We use Google Analytics, with IP anonymisation switched on, to understand how Spotly is used. No advertising cookies are used. You can clear local storage or block cookies in your browser settings, but parts of Spotly may not work properly.

Your Rights

  • Be informed about how your data is used
  • Access your personal data and get a copy
  • Correct data that is wrong or incomplete
  • Ask us to delete your data
  • Object to, or ask us to restrict, certain uses of your data
  • Receive your data in a portable format
  • Withdraw your consent at any time
  • Not be subject to a decision made only by automated means that significantly affects you — we do not make such decisions

To use any of these rights, use the Contact Us page (choose “Privacy / Data Request”) or email support@spotly.ng. We may need to confirm who you are first. If you are not happy with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (ndpc.gov.ng).

Children

Spotly is for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18 without a parent or guardian’s consent. If you think a child has given us their data, contact us and we will delete it.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last Updated” date shows the latest version, and we will tell users about significant changes where possible.

By using Spotly, you confirm that you have read this Privacy Policy. Where we need your consent — for example for ID verification, precise location or push notifications — we ask for it separately and you can withdraw it at any time.
Spotly Privacy Policy · September 2026

Terms & Conditions

Please read these terms carefully before using Spotly.

Last Updated: September 2026

1. About Spotly

Spotly is an online platform where people can find properties — such as houses, land, shops and offices — and contact the agents who list them. Spotly is not an estate agent, landlord, seller or property manager. Spotly does not own, sell, rent, inspect or guarantee any property listed on it, and is not a party to any tenancy, sale, purchase, agency or other agreement made between users and agents. Any inspection, negotiation, payment or agreement happens directly between you and the agent.

2. Who Can Use Spotly

You can search for properties without an account. To create an account or list a property you must be at least 18 years old and able to enter a legally binding agreement under Nigerian law. You agree to give accurate information, keep your login details safe, and tell us if you think your account has been misused. You are responsible for what happens on your account.

3. If You Are Looking for a Property

  • Treat listings as advertisements, not confirmed offers
  • Inspect the property in person before you pay or sign anything
  • Check that the agent is authorised to deal in the property and ask to see the relevant documents, such as ownership papers and any tenancy or sale agreement
  • Confirm every fee and charge (including agency and legal fees) in writing before you pay
  • Keep receipts and written agreements
  • Communicate respectfully and do not use Spotly for any unlawful purpose

4. If You Are a Property Agent

  • List only properties you own or are authorised to advertise
  • Give accurate, current details — price, location, size, condition — and photos of the actual property
  • Mark a property unavailable or remove it promptly once it is sold, let or withdrawn
  • Tell people clearly, before they pay, about every fee and charge (including agency, commission, legal, inspection and caution fees), and give a receipt for any money you collect
  • Hold every licence, registration or permit that Nigerian law or your State requires for your activity — for example, registration with the Estate Surveyors and Valuers Registration Board of Nigeria (ESVARBON) where it applies, or with the Lagos State Real Estate Regulatory Authority (LASRERA) for estate agency in Lagos State. You alone are responsible for this; Spotly does not check your licences unless it says so
  • Follow the tenancy, land, tax, consumer protection and anti-discrimination laws that apply to your listings
  • Never ask anyone to pay for a property you do not control, and never collect money by misrepresentation
  • Treat everyone respectfully

5. Listings and Content

You keep ownership of the photos, videos, descriptions and other content you upload (“your content”). By uploading it, you give Spotly a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to store, display and promote it within Spotly — including in search, maps, Market posts and shared links — for as long as it stays on the platform. You confirm that you have the right to upload it, that it does not infringe anyone else’s rights (including copyright), and that it contains nothing unlawful. Do not upload other people’s personal information or images without their permission. Spotly may limit or remove content that breaks these Terms or the law.

6. Identity Verification

Verification confirms that an agent has submitted identification documents that Spotly has reviewed. It does not confirm ownership of any property, the accuracy of a listing, any professional licence or registration, or the quality or honesty of an agent’s service. Always do your own checks.

7. Premium Subscription

  • Premium improves an agent’s visibility in search, on the map and in the Market, and unlocks higher limits
  • Fees are shown in Nigerian Naira (₦) before you pay. Payments are processed by Flutterwave
  • Subscriptions are time-based, expire automatically unless renewed, and can be renewed at any time
  • Fees paid are generally non-refundable, except where Nigerian law — including the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act 2018 — requires a refund or gives you a right that cannot be waived
  • If you were charged incorrectly or a payment failed, contact us using the subject “Payment Issue”

8. Reviews and Ratings

Users may leave honest reviews based on their genuine experience with an agent. Reviews must not contain private personal information. Spotly may remove fake, abusive or spam reviews. Only one review per agent per device is permitted.

9. Prohibited Activities

  • Posting fake, duplicate, misleading or unavailable listings, or listing a property you have no right to advertise
  • Advance-fee fraud, taking money for a property you do not control, or any other fraud or misrepresentation
  • Impersonating another person, agent or company, or falsely claiming a licence or verification
  • Uploading illegal, harmful, obscene or defamatory content
  • Harassing or discriminating against other users
  • Manipulating ratings or creating fake reviews
  • Copying or scraping listings, or interfering with Spotly’s security or normal operation
  • Any activity that breaks Nigerian law, including the Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) Act 2015 (as amended)

We may report suspected crimes to the police or other competent authorities.

10. Reporting and Removing Content

To report a listing, profile, review or other content, use the Contact Us page (choose “Report a Listing”) or email support@spotly.ng, and tell us what is wrong and where to find it. We review reports and may remove or restrict content or accounts. We also act on valid orders or notices from courts and competent Nigerian authorities.

11. Limitation of Liability

To the extent permitted by law, Spotly is not responsible for the accuracy or legality of any listing, for the conduct of any user or agent, or for any agreement, payment, dispute or loss between users and agents — including losses connected with inspections, deposits, rent, purchase payments or fraud by other people. You deal with agents at your own discretion and risk. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits any liability, or any consumer right, that cannot be excluded or limited under Nigerian law, including the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act 2018.

12. Your Personal Data

We handle personal data in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023. Please read our Privacy Policy. Phone numbers and other contact details that agents add to their profiles or listings are shown publicly so that people can contact them.

13. Changes to Spotly and These Terms

Spotly may update, modify or discontinue features at any time. We may also update these Terms. We will tell users about significant changes where possible, for example in the app, and the “Last Updated” date shows the latest version. If you keep using Spotly after a change takes effect, you accept the updated Terms. If you do not agree, stop using Spotly and contact us to close your account.

14. Suspension and Termination

Spotly may suspend or remove listings or accounts that break these Terms or the law, without prior notice in serious cases such as suspected fraud. You can ask us to close your account at any time.

15. Governing Law and Disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. If you have a complaint, please contact us first so we can try to resolve it. You may also refer a consumer complaint to the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC). Nigerian courts have jurisdiction over any dispute that cannot be resolved.

16. Contact

Questions about these Terms? Email support@spotly.ng or use the Contact Us page.

By using Spotly, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.
Spotly Terms & Conditions · September 2026

Community Guidelines

To keep Spotly safe, honest, and trustworthy for everyone.

Be Respectful

Treat all users and agents with professionalism and courtesy. Harassment, insults, or abusive language will not be tolerated.

Be Honest

Use real, accurate information about yourself and your properties. Misleading profiles harm the community and will be removed.

No Spam

Do not send unwanted messages, post irrelevant content, or create misleading listings. Spam accounts will be permanently removed.

No Fraud

Fraudulent accounts, fake identities, and deceptive practices are strictly prohibited. Such accounts will be permanently removed and reported.

Respect Reviews

Do not manipulate ratings or create fake reviews. Reviews must be based on genuine experiences. Only one review per agent is allowed per device.

Upload Appropriate Content

Photos and videos must relate to the properties you list. Offensive, explicit, or unrelated content will be removed immediately.

Protect Your Community

If you notice suspicious activity, fake profiles, or harmful content, report it to Spotly at support@spotly.ng

Together, we build trust.
We can build a trusted property marketplace for agents and property seekers everywhere.
Spotly Community Guidelines · June 2026
